descripcion: 一款免费无广告的 Android 加密 DNS 客户端。支持自定义 DNS（端口可选）、DoH、DoT，且三者可同时启用，而非二选一。基于 Kotlin VpnService + WebView 构建，专为绕过 DNS 污染与解析延迟设计。A free, ad-free Android DNS client with custom DNS (port configurable), DoH, and DoT — all three can run simultaneously, not either/or. Built with Kotlin VpnService + WebView. Designed to bypass DNS pollution and resolution lag.
